data.title: Robotics Stocks Punished Tuesday in AI Sell-Off: Ouster Down 10%, Aeva Technologies Down 12%, Symbotic Down 4%
data.description: A cooling AI trade, a 19-year Treasury yield high, and a cohort of robotics names that doubled into today just became a dangerous combination for investors still holding Physical AI exposure.
data.keywords: Symbotic Inc, top 10 AI stocks, Aeva Technologies, Aeva, Ouster, Symbotic
